pressure.shortDesc: Entry: -1 foe Def/SpD once per foe per user per battle; Cold Eclipse repeats -2. Extra PP cost.
pressure.desc: On entry, lowers foes' Defense and Sp. Def by 1 (2 on Cold Eclipse) and changes Underwater to Midnight Zone. Foes targeting it spend 1 extra PP, or 2 on Midnight Zone. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse retains repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.

lunardread.desc: On entry, lowers adjacent foes Sp. Atk by 1 stage, blocked by Substitute and normal stat-drop protection. Prevents sleep and Yawn; Dark and Ghost attacks have 1.3x power. Retains local Pressure: lowers foes Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stage on entry (2 on Cold Eclipse), costs foes 1 extra PP (2 on Midnight Zone), and changes Underwater to Midnight Zone. No mark, damage-reduction or Ground critical-hit effects. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse retains repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.

moonlightvigil.shortDesc: Blocks Intimidate; opposing moves spend extra PP; reveals Illusions.
moonlightvigil.desc: Prevents flinching and Intimidate's Attack drop. On entry, lowers foes' Defense and Sp. Def by 1 (2 on Cold Eclipse) and changes Underwater to Midnight Zone. Foes targeting it spend 1 extra PP, or 2 on Midnight Zone. Prevents other Pokemon's accuracy drops and ignores evasion boosts. Reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena entry lowers foes' accuracy by 1. Starlight Arena entry gives +2 Sp. Atk and puts Spotlight on its first adjacent ally. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse retains repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.

omenedge.shortDesc: Stronger slicing moves; eligible moves hit twice; foes spend extra PP; physical Doom Desire on fainting.
omenedge.desc: Slicing moves have 1.5x power, except on Cold Eclipse. Eligible slicing, pulse, bullet, horn, drill, and Arrow moves hit twice at 60% power, with an independent accuracy check for each hit. When combined with Sharpness, Mega Launcher, or Power Drill, the first hit receives that boost and the second hit deals 15% of the move's unboosted power. In Free-for-All, both hits use full power: the first hits the selected foe and the second targets another random living foe when possible. Existing multi-hit moves are not given an additional Dual Wield pair. On entry, lowers foes' Defense and Sp. Def by 1 (2 on Cold Eclipse) and changes Underwater to Midnight Zone. Foes targeting it spend 1 extra PP, or 2 on Midnight Zone. On fainting, schedules a physical, 140-power Steel Doom Desire against each foe. An existing delayed attack is delayed by another 2 turns instead. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse retains repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.

royalescort.shortDesc: Once/entry, one successful Order weakens a foe, shields allies or heals allies.
royalescort.desc: Pressure: opposing moves targeting it cost 1 extra PP (2 in Midnight Zone). Entry lowers opposing Defense and Sp. Def by 1 (2 on Cold Eclipse); Underwater becomes Midnight Zone. Once per entry, the first qualifying Order grants one reward: Attack Order damaging a foe lowers that foe's Attack by 1; successful Defend Order shields active allies against their next damaging hit by 25%, until the end of the following turn; Heal Order actually healing the holder heals active allies by 1/8 maximum HP. All three share one budget; failures do not spend it. The holder receives no extra ally shield or heal. Shields do not stack. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse retains repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.

irondominion.shortDesc: Entry and Gigantamax activation trigger its stat effects and ally healing.
irondominion.desc: On entry or G-Max activation, it activates Pressure and Mirror Armor's effects and heals its ally like Sworn Duty. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse retains repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.

grapplingclaws.shortDesc: Tough Claws; physical contact HP hits lower one foe's Speed after the move, once per turn.
grapplingclaws.desc: Full local Tough Claws gives contact moves 1.3x power. Dragging Grip: once per turn, after an entire physical contact attack deals opposing HP damage, lowers one surviving active opposing target's Speed by 1. Normal stat-drop prevention and reflection apply. Multi-hit and spread attacks cannot repeat this effect. Misses, protection, immunities and Substitute-only damage do not activate it. Does not trap, prevent healing or cause binding damage.
